Privacy

Updated October 28, 2026

The mandala maker runs in your browser. There's no account, and your designs are never uploaded to us.

  • Your designs. Your current design is saved in your browser's local storage so it's there when you come back. Clearing your browser data removes it.
  • Share links. A share link holds the design itself inside the link. Anyone you send it to can open the design.
  • Analytics. We use Cloudflare Web Analytics to count visits. It doesn't use cookies or track you across sites.
  • Hosting. The site is served by Cloudflare, which processes basic request data such as IP addresses to deliver and protect the site.
